summary: Orchestrator-infrastructure audit of the Measure framework. A1 (substring-as-signal) and A8 (supervisor marker regex) are clean and now guarded by a new tests/orchestrator_supervisor_invariants.sh. The major finding was an A8 regression: 330 deprecated `[ ]` (space) markers across 16 active product tracks — invisible to the supervisor (its regex `^- \[([~xb])\]` ignores `[ ]`) but counted by the status checker, inflating the incomplete-phases report. FIXED: reclassified all 330 (64 in genuinely-deferred tracks -> `[b] deferred:track-owner`; 266 in active tracks -> `[~]`, chosen over `[b]` to avoid reintroducing the A1/A11 class of hiding executable work). The A8 guard (tests/orchestrator_marker_vocabulary.sh) only checked 12 review tracks and missed every product track — expanded to cover all measure/tracks/*/plan.md. doctor.sh was missing the A11 truthfulness test and the new supervisor-invariants test — both wired in. The catalog's Guard: references for A1-A7 pointed at tests/mir_p1.sh / cs_p4.sh / mr_p*.sh which DO NOT EXIST in this repo (A2-A7 were silently unguarded) — cataloged as new A12; A1 and A8 now have real guards. A3/A4/A5/A6/A7/A9/A11 detectors ran clean. The 7 closeout false-positive candidates were confirmed genuinely not-closeout-ready via metadata.json (4 blocked/reopened/superseded + 3 backlog); no stray closeout manifests exist on active tracks, so no manifest needed updating. Remaining open items are non-blocking: A10 (no pre-commit hook AND measure/generate.sh missing), A13 (stale measure/tracks/agents_md_audit_science_advantage_20260603/ leftover dir after archive move), and 2 spec-only tracks missing plan.md. Post-fix, `bash measure/doctor.sh` runs 4 guards and exits 0.
blocking_findings: A8 [RESOLVED]: 330 deprecated `[ ]` (space) task markers across 16 active tracks in measure/tracks/*/plan.md were invisible to the supervisor (regex ignores `[ ]`) yet counted by the status checker, inflating the incomplete-phases report. FIXED: 64 -> `[b] deferred:track-owner` (deferred tracks), 266 -> `[~]` (active tracks). Zero `[ ]` remain in measure/tracks/.

A8 [RESOLVED]: tests/orchestrator_marker_vocabulary.sh only checked 12 hardcoded review-track IDs, so all 16 product tracks regressed silently. FIXED: now globs measure/tracks/*/plan.md (24 plans checked).

doctor.sh [RESOLVED]: only ran orchestrator_catalog.sh + orchestrator_marker_vocabulary.sh; the A11 truthfulness guard (tests/orchestrator_review_execution_truthfulness.sh) existed but was never invoked. FIXED: doctor.sh now runs catalog + supervisor_invariants + marker_vocabulary + review_execution_truthfulness.

A1/A8 [RESOLVED]: no real guard existed for the supervisor-side invariants; the catalog's Guard: refs (tests/mir_p1.sh etc.) were dangling. FIXED: added tests/orchestrator_supervisor_invariants.sh (A1 substring-as-signal + A8 marker-regex + is_task_structurally_blocked positive controls).
nonblocking_findings: A10: no .git/hooks/pre-commit hook AND measure/generate.sh does not exist — doctor.sh Check 5 / generated-facts drift risk on every structural change. Fix requires creating measure/generate.sh first, then a pre-commit hook that runs + stages it.

A13: stale directory measure/tracks/agents_md_audit_science_advantage_20260603/ (only fixtures/, no plan.md/metadata.json) remains in measure/tracks/ while tracks.md line 162 marks the track archived under ./archive/. Archive copy is complete and fixtures are identical; the tracks/ copy is a leftover from an incomplete archive move. Reported for measure-closeout to remove (not removed by the audit per the closeout boundary).

A12: catalog Guard: references for A2 (tests/cs_p4.sh), A3/A4/A5/A6/A7 (tests/mir_p1.sh) point at files that do not exist anywhere in the repo — A2-A7 are unguarded except by manual orchestrator audit. Documented in the catalog; A1/A8 now have real guards. Creating mir_p1.sh/cs_p4.sh equivalents is deferred (low frequency in current tracks).

Plan-truthfulness: 2 active tracks referenced in tracks.md (lines 218, 221) — primary_advantage_agents_md_audit_20260610 and reading_advantage_agents_md_audit_20260610 — have spec.md + metadata.json (status=new) but NO plan.md. Acceptable for queued/pending audits, but plan.md must be authored before execution begins (the supervisor cannot phase-gate a track with no plan).

Reclassification review: the 64 `[ ]` -> `[b] deferred:track-owner` and 266 `[ ]` -> `[~]` flips were performed by the audit per the task's explicit authorization. Per AGENTS.md the plan-update role owns marker truthfulness; the orchestrator's plan-update role should review the reclassified plans and flip `[~]` -> `[x] <SHA>` where evidence on disk shows work is already done (e.g. sales_advantage_mvp metadata notes Phases 0-7 verified present on HEAD).
